stage: exploratory P3 real text after synthetic learning repair

training.train_stream_repetition: deterministic cyclic original order after end EOS

control: spectral_rope derived from Vortex; never separately trained
evaluation: PTQ penalty for QK head, QK group16, K head, QK ring7
interpretation: Prior per-head mechanism evidence is mixed and synthetic PTQ accuracy is saturated. This is an exploratory real-text test, not a claim that the old P1 gate was positive.
scale_budget: Each quantization format uses identical scale partition across methods; ring7 has 7 FP32 scales/head and is not native group16; all quantization simulated.
scope: No changes to system/driver/SDK or old experiments; no /root/wcc access.
budget_rationale: Pilot 8192 tokens/step, ~0.095s RoPE and ~0.105s Vortex: 500M tokens/model projected ~3.4h combined, within 12h available and cumulative 36h cap. Budget fixed before either main training or any final PTQ results.
